result.title: Attention-based Classification for Indirect Prompt Injection
result.summary: Indirect prompt injection (IPI) attacks, in which adversarial instructions are embedded in external data processed by a language model, pose a significant threat to the integrity of deployed LLM agents. Attention Tracker (Hung et al., 2025) is a recently proposed white-box detection method that identifies prompt injection attacks by monitoring how a model's attention is distributed between user task tokens and data tokens, claiming dataset-agnostic detection via a scalar focus score threshold. In this paper, we provide the first evaluation of Attention Tracker in a realistic agentic IPI setting using the AgentDojo benchmark, finding that the dataset agnosticism claim does not hold. We find that in agentic environments, long structured tool outputs subvert the fundamental assumptions Attention Tracker makes about attention that the method depends on and produces near-chance detection on AgentDojo across most model families. We propose AttnDA, an extension replacing the scalar threshold with a Fisher Linear Discriminant Analysis classifier over the per-head focus score vector, and evaluate both methods in a cross-dataset setting spanning four benchmarks. AttnDA improves detection performance across agentic and tool-integrated benchmarks, though transfer to AgentDojo remains challenging regardless of classifier choice. A covariance ablation further shows that removing inter-head correlation structure substantially contributes to performance, with complex covariance assumptions causing significant degradation on cross-domain data. These results indicate that the attentional distraction signal underlying focus-score-based detection does not transfer reliably to agentic environments, and that learned linear classifiers over head-level attention features offer improved detection performance, provided training data from the target deployment domain is available.

AI.brief_summary: 在 AgentDojo 上评测基于注意力分布的间接提示注入检测方法 Attention Tracker，发现其「数据集无关」的标量阈值假设在工具输出较长的 agent 场景中失效；提出 AttnDA，用逐头 focus score 向量上的 Fisher 线性判别替代阈值，并在四个基准上做跨数据集评测与协方差消融。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用逐头注意力特征加线性分类器区分「任务证据 token」与「外部注入内容」，并分析头间相关结构，可供核查能否迁移为判断 VLM 推理是否真正调用了视觉证据、而非被无关上下文干扰的诊断线索；但该文属安全检测，任务与模态均不同。
